title: A Mysterious Letter
description: A sealed letter arrives at your doorstep bearing a strange sigil. The note hints at a hidden sect meeting in the nearby hills.

title: Lost Child
description: A frightened child approaches you asking for help finding their family. Helping may win local favor, but it could be a trap.

title: An Old Tale Retold
description: An elder recounts a long-forgotten tale of a local shrine said to contain a fragment of a spirit stone. Listening may reveal a lead.

title: Midnight Chant
description: You overhear a midnight chant at the edge of the village. The words are unfamiliar but resonate with your Qi. Investigate or avoid?

title: Strange Merchant
description: A wandering merchant offers a small jade amulet that hums softly. It is cheap, but something about it feels off.

title: River Whispers
description: At dawn the river seems to whisper your name. Collecting its water is said to ease cultivation. Do you indulge?

title: A Bandit's Hint
description: You find a crude map tucked under a stone showing a likely bandit camp nearby. The map could lead to treasure or trouble.

choices.text: Turn it in to the local guard
Use it to set an ambush

title: Starlit Omen
description: A meteor streaks overhead and lands beyond the hills. The locals say meteor shards carry strange power. Do you set out to retrieve one?

choices.text: Set out to retrieve a shard
